title: Enforce live expense ownership across CRUD and allocation evidence routes
description: Stage3 core finance closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require current enabled identity, existing expense-bill menu and authoritative customer scope at every expense CRUD/read/list/export-if-present and both legacy and batch allocation preview/generate/list/detail/void route before counts, number allocation or data writes. Scope customer expenses from persisted CustomerId; shared loading sources and batches require every effective participant/customer allowed using exact explicit LoadingListId, SourceExpenseId and generated rows. Restricted users cannot access source-less expenses lacking proven ownership; authorized unrestricted users retain historical access. Never infer scope from free-text RefNo or CustomerName, fabricate grants or bypass unknown ownership.

Validate complete stored/proposed customer scope, real enabled customers, supported currency, positive rounded amount and rate before changing fields or generating any rows. Keep batch-generated fee audit immutability and explicit void semantics; denied edit/delete/preview/generate/void leaves original rows/status/audit and all linked evidence unchanged. Client identity cannot be supplied in body to widen scope. Wire authorization through actual controller/service entry paths without anonymous fallback; no new permission tables, schema or financial posting. SQL actual API/service own/foreign/mixed/unknown/revoked/disabled and denied edit/batch operations plus safe Release tests; real browser evidence or accurate blocker.

implementation_evidence: ExpenseBillController inherits unscoped generic CRUD and calls legacy allocation and ERP042 batch preview/generate/list/detail/void services without current identity. Current requests can read or mutate another customer or shared-container allocation evidence. BaseCrudController.Delete is nonvirtual; authorize minimal virtual extension so expense delete can enforce the same scope without changing other modules.
